human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Separate OpenAIRE raw counts, normalized signals, derived ratios, heuristic flags, finding classification, and display copy. Keep the existing working heuristics unless correctness requires change; do not invent pseudo-scientific field baselines during the deadline freeze. Depends on: 0001.result-semantics-freeze.
human_pressure.why_now: The product must show that its findings come from deterministic measured signals rather than generated prose.
do_not_misread: This is a hackathon freeze pack: improve credibility and demo reliability without widening the product surface.
Repository-specific file paths and validation commands must be mapped from the actual OpenGap repository before execution.
A measured imbalance is a signal, not proof of a scientific research gap.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new model service, vector store, or research-normalization subsystem.
Do not let an LLM generate counts, ratios, trends, or finding kinds.
Do not silently coerce missing entity results to zero.
Do not churn heuristic thresholds solely to make the demo look better.

machine_core.goal: Make OpenGap signal derivation and finding classification deterministic, numerically safe, and independent from display copy or LLM-generated text.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new model service, vector store, or research-normalization subsystem.
Do not let an LLM generate counts, ratios, trends, or finding kinds.
Do not silently coerce missing entity results to zero.
Do not churn heuristic thresholds solely to make the demo look better.
invariants: Reusable outputs equal software plus datasets whenever both signals are available.
Division by zero never produces NaN or Infinity in product state.
The same normalized signals always yield the same finding.
Raw OpenAIRE counts remain the source of truth.
Finding classification is separate from copy rendering.
Dependency 0001.result-semantics-freeze must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
contracts: Pipeline order is raw OpenAIRE response -> normalized counts -> derived metrics -> signal flags -> finding classification -> display copy.
Missing and explicit zero are distinct states.
Heuristic thresholds are product heuristics, not field-normalized scientific truth.
Trend must be derived from explicit temporal evidence or downgraded to insufficient_data.
failure_semantics: If required source signals are unavailable, do not classify a funding/reuse gap from missing values.
If reusable ratio cannot be computed safely, keep it unavailable.
If trend evidence is insufficient, return insufficient_data rather than Growing.

steps.title: Map current aggregation pipeline
details: Locate OpenAIRE response normalization, entity counts, ratio calculation, trend calculation, and finding selection.

steps.title: Normalize research signals
details: Represent publications, projects, software, datasets, reusable outputs, and trend explicitly.

steps.title: Centralize derived metrics and heuristics
details: Calculate project/publication and reusable-output/publication ratios in one deterministic layer.
Centralize current heuristic thresholds with clear names.

steps.title: Harden trend
details: Use an explicit deterministic time-window basis if the data exists.
Otherwise downgrade the UI signal to insufficient_data.

steps.title: Connect classification to Pack 01 taxonomy
details: Apply precedence: insufficient evidence first, then funding imbalance, then reuse imbalance, otherwise no strong structural gap.
If multiple imbalances trigger, choose one primary finding and keep secondary signals non-hero.

acceptance: Missing counts are not treated as zero.
Reusable outputs equal software plus datasets when both are known.
No NaN or Infinity reaches product state.
Same measured signals produce the same finding kind.
Trend has an inspectable basis or is insufficient_data.
Display copy is not used to decide the finding kind.

must_check: Numeric safety for zero and missing values.
Deterministic classification of frozen finding kinds.
Trend basis is deterministic or explicitly insufficient.
Existing valid OpenAIRE count retrieval is not rewritten without necessity.
reject_if: An LLM or generated prose decides a count, ratio, trend, or finding class.
Missing entity results are silently stored as zero.
Heuristic thresholds are presented as scientific baselines without evidence.
Thresholds are modified solely to force golden-demo outcomes.
The implementation fabricates OpenAIRE counts, records, links, trends, or gap evidence.
The implementation expands the frozen MVP taxonomy beyond funding gap, reuse gap, and no strong structural gap.
The implementation weakens validation or changes validation commands merely to obtain a passing result.
The implementation modifies files outside the repository-mapped minimal scope for this pack.
The implementation introduces unrelated architecture or feature work.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Exact OpenGap test framework and concrete test files are not present in the conversation. Before execution, map package scripts and existing focused/component/e2e tests, then select the narrowest existing targets that protect this pack plus the repository normal full validation command where appropriate.
validation_notes.completion_reason: OpenGap repository paths and exact validation targets were not supplied; repository mapping is required before execution.

completion_constraints: Inspect the actual OpenGap repository before filling file scope or commands.
Map only existing files that directly implement the behavior described by this pack.
New test files may be added only when the existing test layout clearly supports them and they are listed in machine_core.files.create.
Use exact runnable commands from the repository; no shell globs and no invented scripts.
After completion, perform a deterministic schema and scope recheck before coder execution.
